title: Financial Controller
description: Om tjänsten Vi söker nu, på uppdrag av en av våra kunder, en Financial Controller till deras verksamhet i Uppsala. Rollen passar dig som har 3–5 års erfarenhet inom controlling, redovisning eller ekonomisk analys och vill ta nästa steg i en analytisk och affärsnära roll. Som Financial Controller blir du en viktig del av ekonomiavdelningen och arbetar med rapportering, analys, uppföljning och utveckling av ekonomiska processer. Du får en central roll i att säkerställa kvalitet i finansiell information och bidra med beslutsunderlag till verksamheten. Arbetsuppgifter Arbetsuppgifterna kan variera, men innefattar bland annat: Ansvara för månads- och årsbokslut samt finansiell rapportering Analysera resultat, kostnader och nyckeltal Ta fram budget, prognoser och ekonomiska beslutsunderlag Följa upp verksamhetens ekonomiska utveckling Genomföra kontoavstämningar och kvalitetssäkra finansiell information Identifiera avvikelser och föreslå förbättringsåtgärder Stötta verksamhetens chefer i ekonomiska frågor Utveckla och effektivisera rapporterings- och controllingprocesser Bidra i olika ekonomiska projekt och analyser Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som: Har en akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning eller motsvarande Har 3–5 års relevant erfarenhet inom controlling, redovisning eller ekonomisk analys Har god förståelse för finansiell rapportering och ekonomiska processer Är analytisk, noggrann och strukturerad Har mycket goda kunskaper i Excel Har god systemvana och lätt för att sätta dig in i nya system Är kommunikativ och trivs med att samarbeta med olika delar av organisationen Meriterande Erfarenhet av budget- och prognosarbete Erfarenhet av BI- och rapporteringsverktyg Kunskaper inom koncernredovisning Erfarenhet av ERP-system som SAP, Microsoft Dynamics eller liknande Kunskap om IFRS eller K3 Erfarenhet av processutveckling och automatisering Om anställningen Heltid Placering i Uppsala Arbetstider enligt överenskommelse Start enligt överenskommelse Låter det som nästa steg i din karriär? Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

As a Financial Controller, you become an important part of the finance department and work with reporting, analysis, follow-up and development of financial processes. You will have a central role in ensuring quality in financial information and contributing decision-making support to the business. title: Financial Controller
description: Om oss Nova Health Group grundades med en vision om att revolutionera psykiatrin och behandling av psykiska ohälsa. Vi strävar efter att erbjuda en modern och patientcentrerad vårdupplevelse. Vi vill erbjuda Europas bästa utredning och behandling för personer med ADHD, Autism och annan psykiatrisk problematik. Vi arbetar idag mot våra patienter med varumärkena Nova Psykiatri och Karla Psykiatri, men med fler företag på gång inom gruppen. Dagens psykiatri präglas av traditionella metoder och ett ofta långsamt arbetssätt, där tekniska framsteg och patientens behov sällan står i fokus. Många patienter har svårt att navigera i ett komplext offentligt system eller vänder sig till stora vårdgivare där de riskerar att bli en anonym siffra i mängden. Vi har valt att göra saker annorlunda genom att sätta patienten i centrum och erbjuda psykiatrisk vård med en femstjärnig service. Vår strategi bygger på patientupplevelse, kvalitet och effektivitet, där vi använder modern teknik och innovativa arbetsmetoder för att ständigt förbättra och utveckla vår verksamhet. Vårt engagerade team är kärnan i vår verksamhet och består främst av psykologer, läkare och sjuksköterskor. Nova grundades 2024 och har idag 70+ medarbetare – och vi växer snabbt. Nu söker vi fler drivna personer som vill vara med och forma framtidens psykiatri tillsammans med oss. Vi lägger mycket fokus på att anställa Sveriges duktigaste medarbetare, men även att folk ska trivas bättre här än någon annanstans. Novas vision är att visa hur psykiatri kan fungera, för såväl patienter som för medarbetare. Vi tror det går att göra mycket bättre. Vi drivs av att hela tiden förbättra patientnöjdheten, hålla hög kvalitet, och samtidigt höja effektiviteten genom minskad administration. Vi tror att vi når allt detta genom att ha kul tillsammans, våga göra misstag, samt genom att våga sträva mot att vara bäst på det vi gör. Om rollen Vi söker en Financial Controller som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för redovisning och rapportering på Nova – med ett stort fokus på AI och automatisering. Det är inte en roll där du följer en checklista, du förväntas utveckla rollen i takt med att vi snabbt expanderar verksamheten. Du har full koll på detaljerna, men lyfter blicken när något inte ser rätt ut. Du ifrågasätter, förbättrar och bygger strukturer som skalar i takt med att Nova växer i Sverige och andra marknader. Det finns goda möjligheter att växa i rollen och med bolaget. Rätt person tar mer och mer ansvar för ekonomiavdelningen som helhet och rollen utvecklas därefter. title: Quant Risk and Valuation Sales Manager for the Nordics
description: About Infront At Infront, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace, recognizing our diverse team as one of our most valuable assets. For 25 years, Infront has been empowering financial market experts to make faster, smarter, compliant decisions. Over time, we have expanded our foundation by bringing together companies with more than 75 years of combined market experience and trust. Our strength lies in market data, delivering reliable, accurate information through a powerful suite of tools, spanning Data Intelligence, Wealth Management solutions, and Trading & Investor solutions, that our users depend on every day. Today, we are one of Europe’s leading providers of market data and financial software, helping professionals navigate markets with confidence and speed. About the Role We are seeking a high-performing Sales Manager to drive the growth of our Data Intelligence business across the Nordics. This role will focus on a combination of new business acquisition and expansion within existing accounts, targeting financial institutions looking to enhance their valuation, risk management, regulatory reporting and market intelligence capabilities. The successful candidate will play a critical role in positioning Infront Quant’s Risk and Valuation solutions that help financial institutions improve decision-making, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency and risk management. This is a unique opportunity to drive meaningful market expansion by bringing a flexible and integrated suite of Data Intelligence solutions to a broad range of financial institutions. Combining strategic new business development with account growth initiatives, you will have a direct impact on increasing market adoption, expanding client relationships and helping shape the continued success of our Data Intelligence business. As our Quant Risk and Valuation Sales Manager, your key responsibilities will be: Drive new client acquisition across the Nordic financial services market. Identify opportunities to introduce Valuation & Risk, Regulatory Solutions and Data and Market Intelligence offerings into target accounts. Develop opportunities to expand adoption of risk and valuation solutions within existing accounts. Build and manage a sustainable sales pipeline, from prospecting through to close. Conduct consultative sales engagements, understanding client workflows and business challenges. Deliver compelling product demonstrations focused on valuation, risk, regulatory and market intelligence workflows. Position risk and valuation solutions as part of a broader Data Intelligence ecosystem, including valuation and risk solutions, regulatory solutions, market intelligence solutions, and data feeds and analytics capabilities Target key market segments, including asset managers, investment managers, banks, insurance companies, and financial institutions Develop tailored growth strategies for both existing client expansion and new business acquisition opportunities. Partner with regional sales teams to identify cross-selling opportunities and maximise market penetration. Who you are You are a proactive and results-oriented sales professional with a genuine passion for financial markets, data intelligence and financial technology. Combining a strong commercial mindset with excellent relationship-building skills, you are able to develop trusted partnerships across the financial services industry and consistently identify opportunities to drive growth and deliver results. You are a good match for this role if you: Have a minimum of 5 years of sales experience within financial technology sales, focusing on regulatory risk and/or financial data solutions Have a proven track record selling into financial institutions. Have a strong understanding of valuation and risk solutions, regulatory reporting and compliance solutions, market Intelligence solutions, and financial data and analytics workflows You speak English and Swedish fluently; fluency in Norwegian and/or Danish would be an advantage Have the ability to articulate value across front, middle and back-office workflows. Can demonstrate the ability to develop leads through an existing network of industry contacts, execute complex, consultative sales cycles, and deliver high-quality product demonstrations Possess strong commercial acumen with a focus on revenue growth and account expansion. Have experience managing both new business acquisition and strategic account growth. Are comfortable operating as a specialist sales professional within a highly consultative sales environment. Our offer Health & wellness: Benefit from wellbeing initiatives tailored to local needs, including access to an employee assistance programme that provides confidential support to employees and their families. Holiday: Enjoy competitive holiday entitlement aligned with local markets, so you can rest and recharge. Pension: Plan for your long-term financial wellbeing through our pension scheme, supported by employer contributions. Remote work: Enjoy the opportunity to work two days a week from home, with flexible working hours where possible. You may also request to work up to four weeks per year from a different location. Learning & development: Support your career progression with access to learning resources, ongoing conversations with your manager, and opportunities to share the knowledge you gain with your team. Culture & impact: Be part of an international team with a startup mindset and play a key role in making a meaningful impact. Our offices: Work from Europe’s leading financial centres and be at the heart of where finance happens. Additional notes All candidates selected for employment are subject to Pre-Employment Screening. This process includes professional reference and background checks conducted by our third-party partner, ZINC. These screenings are part of our commitment to ensuring a secure, compliant, and trustworthy workplace. We kindly ask that you submit your CV in English.

title: Off-cycle M&A Intern- Stockholm
description: The M&A internship is well suited to a student or recent graduate seeking insight into principal side dealmaking within a private equity-owned group. It offers experience in an entrepreneurial environment where interns can make an immediate impact and work on live transactions from day one. We are looking for an intern to join the M&A team within Aspia Group Business Development. The internship is expected to last six months on a full-time basis, starting in January 2027. As an intern, your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to: Screening and evaluating potential acquisition targets, including conducting segment, market and company research Building financial models and valuation analyses, including DCF, LBO, comparable company and precedent transaction analyses Supporting the preparation of non-binding offers, letters of intent, investment committee papers, Board materials and management presentations Assisting in the execution of live transactions, including coordinating due diligence workstreams Requirements Currently pursuing, or recently completed, an MSc or BSc in finance, economics, industrial engineering or a related field, with excellent academic credentials Strong quantitative and analytical skills, accuracy and attention to detail A self-starting approach to problem solving, reliability and the ability to deliver at pace across parallel tasks Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; financial modelling experience from studies, internships or casework is an advantage Previous experience in investment banking, corporate finance, private equity or in-house M&A is an advantage Fluency in written and spoken Swedish and English About Aspia Aspia is a leading Nordic provider of technology-enabled accounting, payroll, tax and advisory services. From more than 100 offices across the Nordics, we deliver the business critical work that keeps both SMB and enterprise customers running. Since 2023, Aspia has been owned by Vitruvian Partners, an international private equity firm with more than €20 billion in assets under management. With Vitruvian’s backing, Aspia has committed to delivering the majority of its growth through 2030 via M&A, reinforcing the critical role of inorganic expansion in shaping Aspia’s long-term strategy and value creation. Does this sound like an interesting opportunity to you? If so, we look forward to receiving your application! You can easily apply by submitting your CV and answering a few screening questions directly in our recruitment system. Due to GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please note that selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Contact: If you have any questions about the position, please contact the hiring manager, André Lerdell: andre.lerdell@aspia.se If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact the responsible recruiter, Talia Brorsson: talia.brorsson@aspia.se We use a competency-based approach throughout our recruitment process and make an objective, holistic assessment of your skills, experience, and potential to grow in the role. Tillsammans är vi inom Aspia Group över 3100 medarbetare på fler än 160 kontor i Sverige, Finland, Norge, Danmark, Nederländerna och Ukraina. Aspia är det självklara valet både för dig som söker ditt första jobb och för erfarna experter som vill ta nästa steg i karriären. Hos oss får idéer och individer växa i en inkluderande, rolig och kreativ miljö och det är på Aspia vi vill att du ska ha den bästa tiden i din karriär!

title: Finance and Business Development Specialist with Focus on China
description: About the Job Hanssons is a seafood trading company based in Gothenburg, Sweden. Following its acquisition by Bohai Aquatic Products, a company based in Binzhou, Shandong Province, China, Hanssons is entering a new stage of development with increased focus on international cooperation, financing and business development between Sweden and China. We are now looking for a Finance and Business Development Specialist to support the company’s work with cross-border financing, group coordination and business development. The role involves close cooperation with both Hanssons in Sweden and the parent company in China. Job Responsibilities In this role, you will: Support the company in identifying and preparing financing opportunities through Chinese banks and financial institutions. Help strengthen communication and cooperation between the parent company and the Swedish subsidiary. Support the parent company’s understanding of Hanssons’ operations, market position, financial situation and business needs. Assist Hanssons with group reporting, budget follow-up, cash flow analysis and financial planning. Develop and evaluate financing solutions for Hanssons’ planned new facility construction through Chinese banks and financial institutions. Qualifications We are looking for a candidate who has: A master’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, economics, international business or another relevant field. Experience in auditing, financial analysis, accounting, controlling, corporate finance, banking communication, international trade or business development. Good understanding of financial statements, budgeting, cash flow and corporate finance. Experience working with Chinese companies, Chinese banks or China-related business processes. Very good knowledge of Mandarin Chinese and English, both spoken and written. The ability to work independently and coordinate communication between parties in different countries and time zones. Knowledge of Swedish is meritorious but not required. Experience from the seafood industry, food trading, import/export or international trading business is also meritorious. Personal Qualities As a person, you are structured, responsible and analytical. You have strong communication skills and enjoy working in an international environment where cooperation with people from different business cultures is required. You are detail-oriented, commercially minded and able to handle both financial and business-related matters in a professional way. Great importance will be placed on personal suitability. We Offer We offer a key role in an international company with strong business links between Sweden and China. The position provides an opportunity to work closely with company management and contribute to the company’s continued development in financing, group coordination and international business development.

description: Job Description WHAT YOU’LL DO We are seeking a skilled and experienced Software Engineer with expertise in React, Typescript, and Next.JS to join our dynamic development team. As an experienced Frontend Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing the user interface of our web applications using React and related technologies. You will work in an agile team and collaborate with our product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable, and user-friendly software solutions. Some of your responsibilities will include: Design, develop, and maintain responsive, accessible, and high-performance web applications for COS application in Portfolio Brands Strong working experience in Next.js, React, Typescript, Tailwind CSS, Github actions Experience in system design, headless CMS, component-driven architectures, e-commerce, SaaS, or large-scale enterprise applications Based in Stockholm and come to H&M Office in Stockholm atleast 4 days in a week Collaborate with product owners, UX/UI designers, architects, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Drive technical excellence through code reviews, design reviews, and implementation of engineering standards. AI First development mindset Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Experience working in Agile development environments. Strong understanding of frontend architecture patterns and state management solutions. Strong integrating RESTful APIs and GraphQL working with backend services. Proficiency with version control systems such as Git. Experience with testing frameworks and automated testing strategies. Experience with cloud platforms Azure, or Aws or Google Cloud. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH The Portfolio Brands domain enables brand-unique customer experiences and partnership solutions for our four Portfolio Brands. The domain has three areas, PB Digital Experience delivering the e-commerce platform and associated customer facing experience, PB Store Experience enabling our brands to create lasting store experiences for each brand and PB Partnership Solutions supporting PBs growth agenda through external sales. Digital Experience delivers the e-commerce platform and the ecosystem of composable solutions for our Portfolio Brands, ensuring unique brand experiences can be implemented. The area leads business development and expertise across the e-commerce platform, digital marketing and omni-channel experience, ensuring stable operations as well as strategic vendor management. COS offers a wardrobe of ready-to-wear, and accessories rooted in exceptional quality and lasting design. The creative soul of the brand is fuelled by a deep connection to modern culture, dynamic global cities and compelling fashion movements. With an emphasis on expert craftsmanship, innovation and materiality, collections are created with a mindful approach, seamlessly blending contemporary and timeless. Qualifications WHO YOU ARE We are looking for people with… Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and 6+ years of experience as a Software Engineer. Proven work experience as a Frontend Engineer, preferably with a focus on Next.JS Strong proficiency in JavaScript, Typescript, HTML, and CSS. Experience in system design, headless CMS, component-driven architectures, e-commerce, SaaS, or large-scale enterprise applications Experience with React.js and its core principles. Experience with Node.js is preferable. Strong communication skills to collaborate with our clients and gather requirements. Familiarity with popular React libraries and frameworks such as Redux, React Router, or Next.js. Understanding of responsive design principles and mobile-first development. Knowledge of frontend build tools and module bundlers such as Webpack or Babel. Experience with version control systems, preferably Git. Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate technical concepts. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and frameworks. Experience with backend technologies and RESTful APIs. Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest or React Testing Library. Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and ability to work closely with designers. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies Additional Information WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. Staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to Swedish market. 30 days vacation, health care allowance and good work-life balance. Additional perks and discounts from Benify. JOIN US Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. This is a fulltime permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden. Apply as soon as possible by sending in your CV in English. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!
